kernel_architectures_source: cmake/external_projects/qutlass.cmake:56-85 (QuTLASS compiled for SM100; SM100 selected when SM120 is also requested, :72-79); fp_quant.py:64 min capability 100
examples: The quantization method fp_quant is not supported for the current GPU. Minimum capability: 100. Current capability: 90.
curation: Hand-curated for the Phase 1b §10 fix proof; the source scanner must not overwrite this file. v2 replaces retarget_capability with substitute_artifact (PLAN §10.1 fallback). Evidence: v1's fix moved ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3-0.6B-FPQuant-RTN-MXFP4 to a B200; the capability check passed, then weight loading failed ('no module or parameter named ...backward_hadamard_matrix', boot report 1220e2bb9d9e3077ec36a3b1996d3fa982eb9268665a8054c69a161934461b3fd41d, 2026-09-27). v0.29.0 fp_quant.py:198-209 registers forward_hadamard_matrix only, and all 32 FPQuant checkpoints on the Hub store backward_hadamard_matrix (safetensors headers, 2026-09-27), so no GPU makes them load. substitute_artifact serves the same network in a format the pinned engine runs on the requested GPU. kernel_architectures still excludes fp_quant candidates on GPUs its kernels were not built for.
